high_level_description: stc brand style, a minimalist purple line-art illustration of two figures interacting with a large smartphone displaying icon graphics.

compositional_deconstruction.background: An empty white background that keeps focus on the illustrated figures and smartphone.

elements.desc: A figure on the left wearing a long robe and a traditional hijab, drawn in a simple geometric purple outline style.
A figure on the right wearing casual clothing and a cap, drawn in the same minimalist purple outline style.

A large smartphone device between the two figures, its screen showing a red triangle with a lightning bolt icon in the top left, a document icon in the top right, and a wavy line pattern in the center.
